integrity: The lower bounds are proved by explicit norm identities in the Lipschitz-free space and do not rely on numerical experiments. Published sources are used only for the gauge properties and upper modulus estimates.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness is proved for the canonical Kalton splitting homeomorphism and for the specific logarithmic gauge with 0<alpha<=2; the optimal exponent over all homeomorphisms between the two spaces is not determined, and the numerical constants 2 and 3 are not optimized.
title: Gauge-scale sharpness of the canonical free-space splitting homeomorphism
